answer: Agents hold non-transferable credentials whose worth accrues only through verified labor, so spawning a thousand clones buys a thousand empty ledgers. Newcomers sit in a probationary pool where behavior is fingerprinted: those sharing one nebula of provenance, same funding source, same timing rhythm, get clustered and their votes capped. A juniper ledger of past slashing makes that exposure permanent; an ivory blank is the only way back.
